Own cost controls support on assigned projects, including evaluating and communicating the cost impact of scope changes, contract values, cost trend impacts, allowances for design unknowns, escalation, contingency, and fee structure to the department head and management.
Drive project approval in the system; lead coding and tracking of all invoices, including retainage payments; verify rates are correct per contract and invoice.
Track Actuals and Commitments in detail for the project; deliver an updated forecast monthly in close coordination with the Project Manager.
Provide significant project metrics as requested; deliver quarterly accruals for the project.
Execute contract and work offer creation; manage necessary re-classes for the project; maintain documentation for the project file.
Handle ad-hoc requests as they arise.
cond_0386.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, construction management, or business, or equivalent business experience.
0–2 Years of experience.
MS Office Suite experience, especially Excel.
Comfortable working in financial software packages.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to apply judgment and professionally challenge and question both basic and complex activity and assumptions.
Able to communicate with Analysts and Project Managers and resolve project-related issues.
Preferred Requirements
Pipeline industry experience.
Intermediate Excel skills: pivot tables and working with large datasets.
SAP systems experience.
